honest_notes: dadosabertos.anac.gov.br CKAN no longer resolves (DNS -> private) and ANAC's open 'lista de processos sancionadores' CSV covers ONLY airport concessions, so no filterable airline fine dataset exists for 2022-2026; all information-motif ANAC decisions with final amounts that we could verify in the 2018-2021 window are cited, but NONE dated 2022-2026 was found - the Junta Recursal repository migrated to gov.br pages behind Incapsula bot-challenges (curl+extract blocked; browser folder views empty). The Iberia R$1.3M is a PROPOSED sanction in a 2022 Senacon technical note, not a final amount. Itapemirim R$468,186.66 comes from Valor (secondary). The corpus defect rate given to me (37/62 readable BR-issued tickets = 59.7%) could not be reproduced exactly from the wave1/wave2 JSONs: re-counting with filename dedup gives 39/79 (49.4%); both rates are shown in the estimate. LATAM fee values verified via Wayback capture 2026-04-17 because the live latamairlines.com page refuses curl (HTTP 000) and no longer renders the block in extractors; page itself displays the numbers doubled ('97 97'), a rendering artifact, interpreted as R$97/162/216. TJDFT case law is genuinely split: found and cited a small-claims acordao (2014) that DISMISSED damages over English-language tickets ('no translation needed'), so the 'ambiguity shifted the burden' line is anchored on STJ Tema 164 / art.47 doctrine rather than an English-ticket damages award, which I could not locate with a public case number. No BRL totals for NF-e rejections are published; mechanism + official codes cited instead.
